deployable_scope.all_other_sectors: frozen exactly at the sequential reviewed fallback action
deployable_scope.critical_sector_stream_action: fixed RZF directions, continuous per-stream scales, conducted protected-subband power no greater than reviewed fallback sector budget
deployable_scope.critical_serving_sectors: serving sectors of currently floor-violating active eligible users
deployable_scope.external_and_eess_sector_action: one frozen-grid sector scalar, backoff/mute only; never above reviewed fallback

diagnostic_oracles: global frozen 0--12 dB plus mute sector-grid MILP
optimistic all-other-streams-muted single-user EESS-safe upper bound
forbidden: increase numerical tolerance to hide failure
use sum rate as primary objective

objective.primary: all active eligible-user floors and all physical-second long/short EESS constraints
objective.secondary: minimum weighted L1 deviation from sequential reviewed fallback

repair_hierarchy: bounded sparse local frozen sector-grid repair
bounded power-preserving critical-sector fixed-RZF stream redistribution plus sparse external/EESS backoff
global exact oracles for feasibility classification only
optimistic single-user fixed-class upper bound if deployable action is unresolved
